title: Add shared TimeTakenField composable
description: A compact, embeddable time-of-day picker (Material3's TimeInput, not the full clock-dial TimePicker -- TimeInput is designed for exactly this, embedding inside another dialog) shared by AddDoseDialog and EditDoseDialog. Seeds hour/minute from initialEpochMillis's existing date; as the user changes hour/minute, recombines them with that SAME original date via java.util.Calendar and reports the new full timestamp via onEpochMillisChange -- this only ever adjusts time-of-day, never the date, matching this app's other date/time handling (java.util.Calendar/SimpleDateFormat, no new date library).
acceptance_criteria: @Composable fun TimeTakenField(initialEpochMillis: Long, onEpochMillisChange: (Long) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier)
Uses rememberTimePickerState(initialHour, initialMinute, is24Hour = false) seeded from initialEpochMillis via Calendar.HOUR_OF_DAY/MINUTE

A LaunchedEffect keyed on the picker state's hour and minute recombines them with initialEpochMillis's original date (year/month/day unchanged) and calls onEpochMillisChange with the resulting epoch millis
Renders a label (stringResource(R.string.time_taken_label)) above a TimeInput(state = ...)
Requires @OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class) on this composable itself (TimePicker APIs are experimental) -- callers do not need their own opt-in since it's fully contained here
